articles.title: Saudi Arabia warns of potential danger in Yanbu oil hub as Houthi attacks continue
articles.description: Nov 5 - Saudi Arabia issued alerts on Thursday warning of potential danger in Yanbu, the kingdom's Red Sea oil export hub, as Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis continue attacks on the kingdom that have opened another front in the US-Israeli war on Iran. articles.title: Iranians celebrate setback for Trump in US election, and other Mideast news
articles.description: Iran’s leaders say President Donald Trump shouldn’t ignore the stinging setback in the U.S. election. Iranians celebrated after U.S. voters gave Democrats control of Congress in Tuesday’s vote in a rebuke of Trump. Iran’s chief negotiator and parliament speaker said that Americans clearly said no to war. World leaders and those in the Middle East are now waiting to see whether Washington will end the war with Iran or resume full-scale military operations against Iran. Meanwhile, the Iran-backed Houthis claimed they fired strikes on an airport in the Saudi Arabian capital of Riyadh and other targets around the country.
